feature_contract.goal: Correct native R84 stereo accounting across both XYZRHW fixed-function and shader-backed ScreenHud early-rejection paths so a source admission veto or failed left-eye c64 upload cannot falsely mark a GPU draw, lose the mono-backup baseline or advance depth generation without any raster submission.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 R30 shared GPU draw accounting and failed pre-left WVP upload only. Original +TIME/GOAL/rank producers, center flare semantics, R26_SAFE rollback, SkyGlow, native input and FFB, and DX11/DXVK branches remain unchanged.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Verified exact code-level failure: R9NoteStereoDrawWithoutMonoBackup increments R9DrawCalls and sets R9MonoBackupGap before R30 exactRank/stage/GOAL/FVF142 rejection, and also before R30 shader left WVP upload; R9UndoStereoDrawCount only decrements the count without clearing the gap. Main depth content serial likewise increments before a raster draw exists.
trace_stages: Original native +TIME/GOAL/HUD/rank producer enters R84 R30 exact source gate without an actual physical Draw yet.
R30 XYZRHW or shader-backed source admission/c64 upload can reject with E_NOTIMPL before actual left draw; before fix R9 frame flags/depth serial were already modified.
Only after successful pre-left admission/accounting does native left GPU Draw execute, followed by right-eye RT/Depth/WVP restoration and conservative mono fallback on actual hardware failures.
subcomponents: Relocate XYZRHW per-frame mono-backup and main-depth accounting behind all exact source and fixed-function rank admission checks, preserving no-eye E_NOTIMPL fallback.
Relocate shader ScreenHud/SceneEffect accounting after successful left-eye c64 upload; eliminate bogus R9 draw-count undo while preserving left WVP rollback and fail-closed right-eye safety.
Add enforced shipping R84 source-order positive and negative mutation regression to the existing HUD/P0 verifier without disabling build, fallback, original SkyGlow or R26_SAFE checks.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A rejected native-source/FVF142 pre-left R30 path never calls R9 draw/depth accounting; accepted owner still accounts once before first actual left GPU Draw.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: When native left c64 upload fails but is rolled back, no draw count, R9MonoBackupGap or main-depth generation change occurs and the original E_NOTIMPL fallback remains available. Failed restoration continues to trigger mono recovery.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows x86 R84 game, x64 host, R26_SAFE package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Material C++ and negative source mutations pass affected verifier and required exact-SHA GitHub Actions; matching Quest3 HMD remains separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Confirmed by native source code, not an observed Quest3 frame; compiler-level/behavioral fault is pre-submit state accounting before admission and WVP upload.
source_trace: R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo gates exact stage/GOAL/rank/FVF142 after R9 draw/depth accounting.
R30TryScreenSpaceFovDraw performed accounting before first eye c64 upload and only decremented draw count on failed upload.
R9NoteStereoDrawWithoutMonoBackup writes R9DrawCalls and R9MonoBackupGap, while R9UndoStereoDrawCount leaves R9MonoBackupGap set.
alternatives_rejected: Changing D3DX Flush/producers, exact semantic tokens or SkyGlow would not correct state flags set before any physical Draw and risks unrelated output.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Left eye native Draw is the earliest legitimate point to account for a stereo submission; right eye and restore are separately recorded and not presumed on any E_NOTIMPL return.
diagnosis.root_cause: R30 frame accounting is performed before the last fallible pre-GPU source and shader resource checks, which can report a raster/draw gap without a physical GPU submission.

notes: Material source correction and P0 verifier with negative mutations staged for final exact-SHA CI. 01037 GOAL work remains independent. No CI/HMD PASS claimed before matching evidence.
